# Feats #348: inert curation evidence

The exact 100 ticket roots are frozen as YAML, with complete-source preview facts and typed, filesystem-backed schema loaders. They are held globally. Character-scoped test adapters materialize only named published examples in isolated tests; they create no accepted assessment or deployed Catalog Release.

`provenance.json` records each root identity/byte hash, the pins and permitted PCGen comparison files. `inherited/` contains exact supporting bodies, including Freeze, Engulf/Smother, Vengeful Outrage, Witch Knife, bloodlines, Crystalline Dust, Ratfolk Swarming, Shabti, druid domains and meditation feats. These are observed source minima, not complete origin or chain coverage. The batch inventory is `scripts/catalog/legal/feats-348.json`.

`preview.json` freezes all 100 complete-source entry facts, including prerequisites resolved against the full pinned lookup. The reduced source fixture deliberately omits unrelated lookup records and has no supporting resources. Tests compare its exact outputs and independently bind the complete-source facts; missing fixture-only name lookup is never invented attribution evidence.

`original-identities.json` freezes every earlier shared record by identity/value, and every previously tracked fixture by path/byte hash, while allowing future additive records. `release.json` is an isolated held-only transport generated from the actual reduced fixture and its exact 100-record curation scope (all shared Situation definitions retained): it contains reports and legal inputs, no admitted definitions or supporting resources. The integration test validates it, prepares it only inside convex-test and checks public legal readback. Production remains unchanged.

The empty `pf1/packs/` directory is retained with `.gitkeep`. Portable reconstruction copies only declared files into `mkdtemp(tmpdir())`, without assuming any particular machine's temporary path. No source runtime, environment file or private directory is executed or copied.
